Kukua Messages.Title: welcome
Kukua Messages.Text: Hello! I'm Kukua, your Corbit X guide. Over the coming months, I'll help you discover what Corbit X means for our customers, branches, and teams. Let's get started.

Kukua Messages.Title: journeyIntro
Kukua Messages.Text: Six stops, six guides. Use the arrows or swipe, and I'll tell you what each one is about.

Kukua Messages.Title: start

Kukua Messages.Title: finish
Kukua Messages.Text: You've reached the end of the journey. Well done! Come back any time to refresh your knowledge.

Kukua Messages.Title: closing
Kukua Messages.Text: Corbit X is more than a system. It's a journey we are taking together. Keep learning, stay informed, and let's prepare for the future.

Journey Stages.Title: Understanding the Transition
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Customers may have questions about account numbers. Corbit X will introduce changes designed to support a smoother banking experience. This guide helps you confidently support every customer conversation.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Here's how to help a customer who arrives with their old account number.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Look up | Find the new account number in Corbit X using the process covered in training.
Serve | Serve the customer and support their transaction.
Share | Share the new account number at every interaction. Encourage its use next time.
Journey Stages.PanelNote: Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Look it up. Share it. Keep banking moving.

Journey Stages.Title: Chequebook Transition
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Chequebook updates can raise customer questions. Understanding the process ensures we provide the right guidance and support.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: My quick tips for cheques that carry old account numbers.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Cheques bearing old account numbers are accepted for six months after go-live, subject to the usual checks. After six months, these cheques will no longer be accepted.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Accept | Accept old-number cheques for six months after go-live, subject to the usual checks.
Encourage | Encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.
Explain | Explain the transition clearly and help customers with their request.

Journey Stages.Title: Supporting Special Cases
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Some situations require special attention. Explore practical ways to help customers and identify available alternatives.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Some older chequebooks can't come with us. Here's how to support those customers with care.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Affected chequebooks recorded in the system more than five years ago will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. These customers have been notified.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Explain | Explain the position with care.
Help | Help the customer access funds through an approved alternative.
Assist | Assist with a new chequebook where required.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Do not turn the customer away. Help them find a solution.

Journey Stages.Title: Operational Preparedness
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Preparation drives success. Learn how readiness activities help teams operate confidently during key milestones.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Here's what happens on the Sunday before go-live, and your part in it.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: On the Sunday immediately before go-live, BOSs will open the branch day. All branch staff will take part in live transaction and channel checks.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Test | Test deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels.
Real funds | These are real transactions with real funds. Follow controls and report issues promptly.
Don't close | Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday.
Continue | Continue the same branch day into Monday. Run end of day at the close of business on Monday.

Journey Stages.Title: Customer Experience First
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Technology will evolve, but our commitment to exceptional customer service remains unchanged.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: My favourite service tips for go-live day. Let your smile lead!
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: Our upgrade should improve the customer experience. Make every customer feel welcome, valued and supported.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Smile & serve | Bring the same warmth, patience and care to every interaction. Keep customers informed and reassured.
Listen & pause | If a customer complains, listen calmly. If you are unsure, pause and check before answering.
Check quickly | Consult the relevant internal team for the information you need to serve the customer well.
Use the repository | Find the relevant guidebook or procedure. The information is at your fingertips, so use it.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Smile. Check. Serve. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

Journey Stages.Title: Keeping Business Moving
Journey Stages.KukuaSays: Business continues while we prepare for change. Discover how we maintain excellent service and support customers throughout the journey.
Journey Stages.PanelKukua: Account opening pauses for a short while, but our welcome never does. Here's how.
Journey Stages.PanelIntro: During the static data freeze in the week before go-live and the first three days after go-live, account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X.
Journey Stages.PanelPoints:
Start | Start in Newgen. Collect all required documents.
Receive | Receive deposits through the designated GL. Record and monitor every deposit.
Finalise | Finalise from Thursday after go-live and provide account numbers.
Journey Stages.PanelSay: We are upgrading our systems to serve you better. We can start your application now. Your account number will be provided from Thursday after the upgrade.
Journey Stages.KeyMessage: Never turn away an account-opening request because of the upgrade.

FAQs.Title: What is Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: Corbit X is our new core banking platform. It replaces Flexcube 11.1 and will power how we serve customers in our branches and across our channels.
FAQs.Keywords: what is corbit x system platform

FAQs.Title: Why are we moving to Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: We're moving to Corbit X to prepare for the future of banking: a modern platform that helps us serve customers better and work more simply as a team.

FAQs.Title: How will customers benefit?
FAQs.Answer: Faster service at the counter, a full 360° view of the customer on one screen, credits and salaries at speed, instant statements for the last 12 months and a more secure account-number format. While we transition, customers are well supported: old account numbers keep working for more than six months after go-live, and cheques with old numbers are accepted for six months.

FAQs.Title: What changes for branches?
FAQs.Answer: A few things to know: new account numbers (look them up in Corbit X and share them), cheque and chequebook changes, a short pause in account opening around go-live, and live checks on the Sunday before go-live. Each one has a stop on the journey.
FAQs.Keywords: branch branches change changes staff operations

FAQs.Title: Where can I find guides?
FAQs.Answer: Right here! There are six guides on my journey. Tap 'View Guide' on any stop to see the full poster.
FAQs.Keywords: guide guides poster posters find where

FAQs.Title: Who can I contact for support?
FAQs.Answer: Start with your Branch Operations Supervisor (BOS). For anything else, consult the relevant internal team. Programme support contacts will be listed here.
FAQs.Keywords: contact support help who phone email

FAQs.Title: Will old account numbers still work?
FAQs.Answer: Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. The new format keeps the same CIF with “00” added in front. Look up the new number in Corbit X and share it with the customer.
FAQs.Keywords: old account number numbers still work accepted

FAQs.Title: Can we open accounts during the upgrade?
FAQs.Answer: Account opening pauses during the static data freeze and the first three days after go-live. Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated GL, and finalise from Thursday after go-live.
FAQs.Keywords: open opening account new freeze newgen

FAQs.Title: How do statements work in Corbit X?
FAQs.Answer: Statements for the last 0–12 months are instant via Corbit X. Older statements (12 months+) come from secure backup, through a cleaner, faster request process.

FAQs.Title: What about cheques?
FAQs.Answer: Cheques with old account numbers are accepted for six months after go-live, subject to the usual checks. Chequebooks recorded more than five years ago won't be migrated, so help those customers find an approved alternative.

FAQs.Title: What happens on the Sunday before go-live?
FAQs.Answer: BOSs open the branch day and all branch staff run live transaction and channel checks with real funds. Don't close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday.
FAQs.Keywords: sunday checks testing test weekend live

Hub FAQs.Title: Will customers' old account numbers still work after go-live?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. Look up the new number in Corbit X using the process covered in training, serve the customer, and share the new number so they use it next time.

Hub FAQs.Title: Can customers still use cheques that show their old account number?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Yes, for six months after go-live, subject to the usual checks. After six months these cheques will no longer be accepted, so encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.

Hub FAQs.Title: What about chequebooks recorded more than five years ago?
Hub FAQs.Answer: These chequebooks will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. Affected customers have been notified. Explain the position with care, help them access funds through an approved alternative, and assist with a new chequebook where required.

Hub FAQs.Title: Can we open new accounts during the upgrade?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X during the static data freeze (the week before go-live) and for the first three days after go-live. Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated GL, and finalise from Thursday after go-live. Never turn a customer away.

Hub FAQs.Title: What happens on the Sunday before go-live?
Hub FAQs.Answer: BOSs will open the branch day and all branch staff take part in live transaction and channel checks: deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels. These are real transactions with real funds. Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday and run end of day at close of business.

Hub FAQs.Title: What should I do if I'm not sure how to answer a customer?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Pause and check before answering. Consult the relevant internal team, or find the guidebook or procedure in the repository. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

Hub FAQs.Title: Will new account numbers be printed for customers?
Hub FAQs.Answer: Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow. Until then, look up and share the new number at every interaction.
